model_selection.calibration: candidate-specific nonnegative through-origin L1 scale c from inner OOF y/p weighted median
model_selection.candidate_oof_prediction: strictly antisymmetric for direct; endpoint difference for E0/E1
model_selection.inner_validation_population: same both-endpoints-inner-validation compatible pairs for every pipeline
model_selection.outer_test_use: selected candidate refit on all outer-train data; apply its frozen inner-OOF c

splitting.algorithm: retain supplied fixed physical-member identity assignments; no reassignment
splitting.endpoint_train_rule: eligible records whose global identity is in current train identities
splitting.global_group: identity_hash across every g and context
splitting.inner_algorithm: retain supplied outer-cell inner identity map
splitting.outer_algorithm: retain supplied fixed physical-member outer map
splitting.train_pair_rule: both endpoint identities in the current train fold
splitting.validation_or_test_pair_rule: both endpoint identities in the current held-out fold

target.name: canonical_target_b_minus_a
target.secondary_membership: abs(y) >= 1 - 1e-12; required equal to frozen is_cliff

representation.dense_model_matrix: float32 dense columns of unfolded IDs; adapters preserve original float64 conversion
representation.environment_identifiers: RDKit 32-bit unsigned hashed environment IDs; not collision-free
representation.name: unfolded_raw_sparse_count
representation.unknown_environments: drop; never expand using heldout or external
representation.vocabulary: sorted IDs from all eligible records in current training identity scope

fingerprint.decode: LSB0 bit-k-at-integer-bit-k big-endian hex to float32

data.pair_filter: all rebuilt compatible edges; no score-based or |y| filtering
data.record_filter: fixed 24 record exclusions from accepted 723; all retained records eligible

external_data.controls: compounds 13/14 retained in source universe but not assigned continuous labels or evaluated
external_data.ensemble: equal weight across all 15 outer final models within learner/pipeline; apply model-specific inner c before average
external_data.training_fraction_note: CV-model ensemble, approximately 80% identity-training data per member; no additional full-data fit

execution.resource_plan: serial queue; one CUDA learner at a time; estimator and BLAS threads four
